999008199.text: こんな所で何をやってるんだい？

localizations.en: What are you doing all the way out here?

999008199.text:
無数島群域にいたのに、
わざわざランターナ大陸まで移動しちゃって

localizations.en: You were in the Infinite Island Chain, but now you've come all the way to the Lantarna continent.

999008199.text:
いやあ、何を言ってるのかな？
僕はただ夜の海を眺めようと思っただけだよ？

localizations.en: Huh? What are you talking about? I just wanted to gaze at the sea at night.

999008199.text: こいつは驚いた。シトリンにしちゃ言い訳が下手すぎる

localizations.en: Color me surprised. That's a terrible excuse, even for you.

999008199.text:
お前さん……まさか、自分一人だけ
ヘル兄の命令に従おうとしてるんじゃないかい？

localizations.en: Don't tell me... you're planning to follow Held's orders all by yourself, aren't you?

999008199.text:
イェルカが気が付いてくれてよかった。
私、まだシトリンのこと、よく知らないから

localizations.en: Good thing Jelka noticed. I still don't know you that well yet.

999008199.text:
……知らないのは僕のことだけじゃない。
ヘルトとゼロのこともだよ。特にヘルト！

localizations.en: ...I'm not the only one you don't know. You don't know Held and Zero either. Especially Held!

999008199.text:
あいつらはやると言ったらやるんだ！
その恐ろしさを知らないんだよ

localizations.en: When they say they'll do something, they do it! You have no idea how terrifying that is!

999008199.text:
だから、従うって？
お前さんは本当にそれでいいのかい？

localizations.en: So you're just going to obey? Is that really what you want?

999008199.text: やらなきゃ、僕が「管理」される側に回っちゃうだろ

localizations.en: If I don't, I'll be the one getting 'managed' next!

999008199.text:
あんた、もっと飄々としてた印象だけど……
それだけ追い詰められてるのね

localizations.en: I thought you were more carefree than this... You're really backed into a corner, aren't you?

999008199.text:
僕からすれば二人がまだ呑気でいられるのが
信じられないよ！

localizations.en: I can't believe you two are still acting so carefree!

999008199.text:
嵐が来たら誰だって逃げ出す！　わざわざ荒れ狂う中に
飛び込んだりなんてしない、それと同じなのに！

localizations.en: When a storm comes, everyone runs! You don't just jump into the middle of a raging tempest—it's the same thing!

999008199.text:
……かつてのアタシは世界中を飛び回ってて、
あの二人と顔を合わせる機会も少なかったが……

localizations.en: ...Back when I was traveling the world, I didn't see those two very often, but...

999008199.text:
どうやらシトリンはヘル兄に
苦い思い出があるみたいだね……

localizations.en: Seems like you've got some bitter history with Held.

999008199.text:
うん。付き合いが浅い私でも分かる。
今のシトリンは怯えてる……

localizations.en: Yeah. Even I can tell, and I barely know you. Right now, you're scared...

999008199.text:
シトリン、落ち着いて。力じゃなくて、
話し合いで……知恵で解決する方法だってあるはずよ

localizations.en: Citrine, calm down. There has to be a way to solve this without force—through discussion, through cleverness.

999008199.text:
だからそれが無駄で、呑気だって言ってるのさ！
君は暴風と話し合いで仲良くなれるのかい？

localizations.en: That's exactly what I'm saying is pointless and naive! Can you make friends with a hurricane through discussion?

999008199.text:
……僕はヘルトの要求通り事を進める。
それが嫌なら力ずくで止めなよ！

localizations.en: ...I'm going to do what Held wants. If you don't like it, then stop me by force!

999008199.text:
戦わずに済む話し合いってやつ……
やっぱり、難しいわね！

localizations.en: Resolving things peacefully through discussion... It really is difficult, isn't it?

999008199.text:
我を忘れてるこの子には、一発お灸を据えて
やる必要があるみたいだね！

localizations.en: Looks like this kid's lost all sense. Time to teach them a lesson!
